q1: SELECT f1.drinker, f2.drinker FROM (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f1, (SELECT drinker, SUM(times_a_week) AS st FROM frequents GROUP BY drinker) AS f2 WHERE f1.drinker < f2.drinker AND f1.st = f2.st
q2: SELECT f1.drinker, f2.drinker FROM frequents AS f1, frequents AS f2 GROUP BY f1.drinker, f2.drinker HAVING SUM(f1.times_a_week) < SUM(f2.times_a_week)

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 finds pairs of drinkers who drink the same amount of times a week, while Q2 finds pairs of drinkers where the first drinker frequents a bar less than the second drinker.
